question: Articles ________ to ________ enunciates the qualifications, functions of the President and his/her tenure, election, method of re-election, and impeachment among others.
solution:
The correct answer is __**52; 62.**__

• **​Articles 52 to 62 of the Constitution of India enunciates the qualifications, functions of the President and his/her tenure, election, method of re-election, and impeachment among others.**
